title: 03 Cadences

sections.title: Cadences: Full, Half, Plagal, and Deceptive

blocks.text: Cadences are harmonic punctuation at phrase endings.
**Authentic (PAC/IAC)**: V→I — full stop. **Half**: ends on V — comma, question. **Plagal**: IV→I — 'amen' cadence. **Deceptive**: V→vi — surprise.
A part often half-cadences at midpoint; B part authentic-cadences home. AABB structure maps to these patterns.
Don't push dominant too early — steals the half cadence's lift.

- A) Authentic cadence
- B) Half cadence
- C) Deceptive cadence
- D) Plagal only

**Answer:** A

sections.title: Q2. Half cadence ends on V.

quiz_markdown:
### Q1. V→I at phrase end:

- A) Authentic cadence
- B) Half cadence
- C) Deceptive cadence
- D) Plagal only

**Answer:** A

### Q2. Half cadence ends on V.

**Answer:** True
